siteTitle: JAV Code Playlist Manager – Save, Organize & Share AV Codes | fanhao.men
siteDescription: Free tool for collecting JAV codes (product codes / IDs like SSIS-123 or FC2-PPV-1234567). Paste codes or URLs in bulk and they're auto-formatted, generate video links in one click, and share playlists by link. No sign-up needed; sign in to sync across devices.
keywords: JAV code,AV code,JAV ID,JAV product code,DVD ID,JAV playlist,JAV list,JAV code manager,FC2 PPV,fanhao
